title: 产品环境提取回环｜材质微距、原料世界、喷雾门户与透明球归返
source_title: 地中海香氛英雄镜｜微距、喷雾与水晶球收束
summary: 从产品材质极近景建立身份，沿核心原料进入环境世界，再由功能动作打开空间门户；环境被压缩进透明体并回到同一产品英雄镜，形成产品—世界—产品闭环。
input_format: Establish one original product through macro material anchors before showing the complete object. + Connect at least two visible ingredient or design details to one coherent environment identity. + Use one functional product action as the sole optical transition into the environment. + Expand the environment, then enclose its recognizable geometry inside one transparent carrier. + Return the carrier and environment to the same complete product with stable shape, label-free identity and hero proof.
recommended_input: 从原创无标签方形矿物台灯的一处斜面内部开始：微距透明石英、拉丝黄铜环和淡蓝内透镜；拉远揭示石台上的完整台灯。；一只明确成年人的手只转动一次同一台灯开关；淡蓝透镜产生一次受控折射光，成为进入峡谷的光学通道，不替换产品。；透明球收缩进台灯淡蓝透镜；回到石台上同一完整方形台灯，石英斜面、黄铜环和比例稳定，不加品牌文字并停住。
required_anchors: Establish one original product through macro material anchors before showing the complete object.
Connect at least two visible ingredient or design details to one coherent environment identity.
Expand the environment, then enclose its recognizable geometry inside one transparent carrier.
Return the carrier and environment to the same complete product with stable shape, label-free identity and hero proof.
